description: Dataset of the 2015 Geo-Hazard Survey of the Yanzi River Basin, Upstream of the Jialing River is a data set described in the paper "Dataset of the 2015 Geo-Hazard Survey of the Yanzi River Basin, Upstream of the Jialing River" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2018), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). This dataset is prepared based on the data and information obtained from the survey of collapse, landslide, debris flow and engineering geology within the Yanzi River Basin, upstream of the Jialing River, in accordance with the unified standards and requirements of the China Geological Survey (CGS). Coverage: the Yanzi River basin upstream of the Jialing River, China, surveyed in 2015. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support collapse, landslide and debris flow susceptibility and risk assessment. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
